```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
})
if (requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ComplexHeatmap))
}
if (is.null(params$report_rds) || !nzchar(params$report_rds) || !file.exists(params$report_rds)) {
  stop("subset report is missing report_rds.")
}
report <- readRDS(params$report_rds)

print_plot <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (inherits(x, "gg") || inherits(x, "Heatmap") || inherits(x, "patchwork")) {
    print(x)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  if (inherits(x, "HeatmapList")) {
    ComplexHeatmap::draw(x)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

# Subset

```{r subset-definition, results='asis'}
kept <- if (length(report$clusters)) {
  paste(report$clusters, collapse = ", ")
} else {
  "an explicit cell list"
}
embedding <- if (isTRUE(report$reintegrate)) {
  "The subset was re-integrated."
} else {
  "RISC kept the parent Integrated_RISC correction. Variable genes, scaling, and PCA were computed on that assay, then the neighbor graph and Louvain were run."
}
cat(sprintf(
  "Parent method: **%s**. Cells kept from `%s`: %s. The subset has %s cells from %s samples. Clustering used %s PCs and resolution %s (`%s`). Pseudobulk mode: %s.\n\n%s\n",
  report$method,
  report$parent_cluster_column,
  kept,
  report$n_cells,
  report$n_samples,
  report$pcs_int,
  report$res_int,
  report$cluster_column,
  if (isTRUE(report$pseudobulk)) "yes" else "no",
  embedding
))
```

# Embedding

```{r dimplots, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (!is.null(report$dimplots$clusters)) {
  print_plot(report$dimplots$clusters)
}
if (!is.null(report$dimplots$condition)) {
  print_plot(report$dimplots$condition)
}
if (!is.null(report$dimplots$code)) {
  print_plot(report$dimplots$code)
}
```

# Stability

```{r stability, results='asis', fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
stab <- report$stability
if (is.null(stab)) {
  cat("PC and resolution were fixed, so no bootstrap was run.\n")
} else {
  if (identical(report$embedding, "reembed")) {
    cat("Bootstrap replicates refit PCA on the frozen Integrated_RISC assay. In the parameter id, N is the number of those PCA dimensions, not the parent RISC eigens value.\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("Bootstrap replicates re-integrated the subset. In the parameter id, N is the number of integrated components.\n\n")
  }
  if (!is.null(report$selected_params_i) && nzchar(as.character(report$selected_params_i)[1])) {
    cat("Selected parameter combination: **", report$selected_params_i, "**.\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  plots <- stab$plots
  if (!is.null(plots$plots)) plots <- plots$plots
  if (is.list(plots)) {
    for (nm in names(plots)) {
      cat("\n\n### ", gsub("_", " ", nm, fixed = TRUE), "\n\n", sep = "")
      print_plot(plots[[nm]])
    }
  }
}
```

# Label transfer

```{r label-transfer, results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
lt <- report$label_transfer
if (is.null(lt)) {
  cat("This object has no predictions assay, so label transfer was not summarized.\n")
} else {
  cat("Per-cell label-transfer scores were averaged within each new cluster. Scores below 0.3 are marked missing. Scores from 0.3 to 0.5 are marked putative.\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(lt$summary))
}
```

# Composition

```{r composition, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
comp <- report$composition
if (!is.null(comp$globalcomposition$hmprop)) {
  print_plot(comp$globalcomposition$hmprop)
}
if (!is.null(comp$composition_plots)) {
  for (nm in names(comp$composition_plots)) {
    print_plot(comp$composition_plots[[nm]])
  }
}
```

```{r composition-table, results='asis'}
comp <- report$composition
if (is.data.frame(comp$composition_results) && nrow(comp$composition_results)) {
  print(knitr::kable(utils::head(comp$composition_results, 30)))
}
```

# Differential expression

```{r de-table, results='asis'}
de <- report$de_top
if (is.null(de) || !is.data.frame(de) || !nrow(de)) {
  cat("Differential expression returned no genes.\n")
} else {
  cat("Top genes per cluster by absolute log fold change.\n\n")
  cols <- intersect(
    c("label", "cluster", "gene_symbol", "gene", "logFC", "avg_log2FC", "PValue", "p_val", "FDR", "p_val_adj"),
    colnames(de)
  )
  show <- if (length(cols)) de[, cols, drop = FALSE] else de
  print(knitr::kable(utils::head(show, 40)))
}
```

# Milo

```{r milo, results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
milo <- report$milo
if (is.null(milo)) {
  cat("Milo was not run.\n")
} else {
  print_plot(milo$size_plot)
  if (is.list(milo$comparisons)) {
    for (nm in names(milo$comparisons)) {
      one <- milo$comparisons[[nm]]
      cat("\n\n## ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
      if (isTRUE(one$skipped)) {
        cat("Skipped: ", one$skip_reason, "\n", sep = "")
      } else {
        print_plot(one$beeswarm)
        print_plot(one$graph)
        print_plot(one$ma)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

# Pathways

```{r pathways, results='asis', fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
pw <- report$pathways
if (is.null(pw)) {
  cat("Pathway analysis was not run.\n")
} else if (is.data.frame(pw$pathway_results)) {
  cat("GSEA summary dot plots. Per-cluster tables are written under the pathway output directory.\n\n")
  plots <- pw$pathwaysummplots_comps
  if (is.list(plots)) {
    for (lab in names(plots)) {
      cat("\n\n## ", lab, "\n\n", sep = "")
      cats <- plots[[lab]]
      if (inherits(cats, "gg")) {
        print_plot(cats)
      } else if (is.list(cats)) {
        for (cat_name in names(cats)) {
          cat("\n\n### ", cat_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
          print_plot(cats[[cat_name]])
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

# ORA

```{r ora, results='asis'}
ora <- report$ora
if (is.null(ora)) {

} else if (is.data.frame(ora) && nrow(ora)) {

} else {

}
```
